parole.significato: Shan (language spoken in eastern Burma in an area bordering China, Laos and Thailand)
parole.testo: From English Shan, from Burmese ရှမ်း (hram:).

parole.significato: Eld's deer, thamin, brow-antlered deer, Rucervus eldii (endangered species of deer endemic to South Asia)
parole.testo: Borrowed from English thameng, from Burmese သမင် (sa.mang).
